leadText: Pocket Monsters B2 W2 ~ A New Legend ~ (Japanese: ポケットモンスターB2・W2 ~新たなる伝説~) is a Pokémon manga that was serialized in CoroCoro Comics starting in the June 2012 issue. The story spanned five chapters. It is written and illustrated by Satoshi Kanda.
